item.title: Trader Joe's issues frozen food recall over glass contamination concerns
item.description: Trader Joe's is recalling several frozen food varieties that may contain glass, urging customers to return products to any store for a full refund.

item.title: Retirement savings grow, yet more workers take hardship withdrawals
item.description: Vanguard reports 401(k) hardship withdrawals rose to 6% in 2025 as access eased, while average balances grew 13% to nearly $168,000.

item.title: US stocks sink after oil spikes to its highest price since the summer of 2024
item.description: Stocks sank on Wall Street Thursday after the price of oil spiked to its highest level since the summer of 2024 because of the war with Iran.

item.title: Lawmakers push to ban government officials from prediction markets after bets on Iran strike, Khamenei's death
item.description: Senators are calling for new legislation after millions of dollars in bets were placed on prediction market sites tied to U.S. air strikes on Iran and the death of the country's supreme leader.

item.title: Kansas City International Airport reopens after potential threat prompts evacuation
item.description: Travelers at the Kansas City International Airport were evacuated Sunday as authorities — including the FBI — investigate a potential threat.

item.title: Crude oil prices spike near $120 a barrel as the Iran war impedes production and shipping
item.description: Oil prices spiked near $120 per barrel before falling back Monday as the Iran war intensified, threatening production and shipping in the Middle East and pummeling financial markets.

item.title: TSA shortages snarl airports as government shutdown stretches into Spring Break
item.description: Travelers faced major disruptions at multiple airports nationwide over the weekend as Transportation Security Administration staffing shortages worsened amid the ongoing partial government shutdown.

item.title: Need a travel snack for kids? Try these crispy buffalo chickpeas
item.description: It’s Spring Break season, and many parents are packing snacks to keep kids happy while traveling, but they still have to make it through airport security.

item.title: Fourth of July fireworks to return to Mount Rushmore despite wildfire risk
item.description: After a five-year hiatus, Fourth of July fireworks are returning to Mount Rushmore this summer and tickets to the show will be available through a public lottery. Drop a 🇺🇸 if you plan to enter.

item.title: Gas and travel prices could continue to spiral as tanker traffic stalls near Iran
item.description: The average price for a gallon of regular gas on Monday was $3.48, up nearly 50 cents from a week ago. And prices could continue to increase with oil tankers held up in the Strait of Hormuz.
